children.label: Server Type
children.description: The type of Minecraft server to run.

children.label: Experimental Paper Version
children.description: Paper provides experimental versions for the latest Minecraft version.

children.label: Paper Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest build version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Fabric Launcher Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Fabric Loader Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Quilt Installer Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Quilt Loader Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Forge Version
children.description: Leave empty for the recommended version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: NeoForge Version
children.description: Leave empty for the recommended version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Modrinth Modpack
children.description: Specify either the Modrinth project URL, the project slug or the URL or path inside the container to an .mrpack file.

children.label: Modrinth Modpack Version
children.description: You can optionally specify a specific modpack version number or ID.

children.label: Modrinth Modpack Version Type
children.description: The latest release or beta version, respectively, of the Modrinth modpack is selected when the Minecraft Version is “LATEST” or “SNAPSHOT”. This can be overridden.

children.label: Modrinth Modpack Loader
children.description: If the modpack supports multiple loaders, you can specify the loader to use.

children.label: CurseForge Modpack URL
children.description: Specify the URL of the CurseForge project page. If you want to use a specific version, specify the URL to the corresponding file page of the project instead.

children.label: CurseForge API Key
children.description: An API key required to access the CurseForge API. The API key can be generated in the CurseForge developer console.

children.label: CurseForge/FTB Server Modpack
children.description: Specify the server modpack ZIP filename, path in the container, or a direct download URL.

children.label: Feed The Beast Modpack
children.description: Specify the modpack ID or feed-the-beast.com modpack URL.

children.label: Feed The Beast Modpack Version ID
children.description: You can optionally specify a specific modpack version ID (extracted from the version file URL).

children.label: Feed The Beast (FTB) (manual)
children.description: Specify the server modpack ZIP filename, path in the container, or a direct download URL.

children.label: Purpur Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: SpongeVanilla Branch
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: SpongeVanilla Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected branch.

children.label: Forge Version
children.description: Leave empty for the recommended version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Ketting Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Mohist Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest build for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Youer Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest build for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Banner Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest build for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Crucible Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest build for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Forge Version
children.description: Leave empty for the recommended version for the selected Minecraft version.

children.label: Magma Maintained Tag
children.description: You can find the supported Forge version and the Magma Maintained Tag on the release page of the respective repository.

children.label: Arclight Mod Loader
children.description: Choose the mod loader you want to use for Arclight.

children.label: Canyon Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest build.

children.label: Limbo Build Version
children.description: Leave empty for the latest stable build.

children.label: Custom Server JAR
children.description: Enter the URL or the file path to the JAR file of the custom server.

children.label: EULA
children.description: Accept the EULA to use this server.

children.label: Max Players
children.description: The maximum number of players allowed on the server.

children.label: MOTD
children.description: The message of the day displayed on the server list. You can use color codes (e.g. &a), formatting codes (e.g. &l) to customize the message, and \n to add a new line.

children.label: Icon
children.description: A URL or file path to a 64x64 PNG image file that will be displayed in the server list.

children.label: Online Mode
children.description: Whether the server should require online mode (require Mojang account verification) or not.

children.label: Use Aikar Flags
children.description: A list of JVM flags to optimize the server performance. These flags are beneficial for most servers.

children.label: Use Meowice Flags
children.description: A list of JVM flags based on Aikar Flags to optimize the server performance, but with improvements for Java 17 and newer.

children.label: Time Zone
children.description: The time zone to use for the server.

children.label: Difficulty
children.description: The difficulty level of the world.

children.label: Enable Hardcore Mode
children.description: Enabling hardcore mode the difficulty is set to hard and the player will be put into spectator mode upon death.

children.label: Enable PvP
children.description: Enabling PvP allows players to fight each other.

children.label: Game Mode
children.description: The game mode of the world.

children.label: Force Game Mode on Join
children.description: Forces the game mode to be set to the selected mode when the player joins.

children.label: Enable Command Blocks
children.description: Enables the command block to be used in the world.

children.label: Enable Nether Dimension
children.description: Allows the Nether to be accessed in the world.

children.label: Allow Animals to Spawn
children.description: Allows animals to spawn in the world.

children.label: Allow Monsters to Spawn
children.description: Allows monsters to spawn in the world.

children.label: Allow Villagers to Spawn
children.description: Allows Villagers to spawn in the world.

children.label: Entity Broadcast Range Percentage
children.description: The percentage of the normal range that entities will be visible to players. Higher values means they will be rendered from farther away, potentially causing more lag.

children.label: Simulation Distance
children.description: The maximum distance from players that living entities may be located in order to be updated by the server, measured in chunks in each direction of the player (radius).

children.label: View Distance
children.description: The amount of world data the server sends the player, measured in chunks in each direction of the player (radius).

children.label: World Generator Seed
children.description: Leave empty for a random seed.

children.label: World Name
children.description: The name of the world to generate.

children.label: World Type
children.description: The type of world to generate.

children.label: Generator Settings
children.description: Additional World Generator Settings

children.label: Generate Structures
children.description: Whether the server should generate structures like villages and strongholds.

children.label: Spawn Protection
children.description: The radius of the spawn protection area.

children.label: Max World Size
children.description: The maximum size of the world.

children.label: Max Tick Time
children.description: The maximum number of milliseconds a single tick may take before the server watchdog stops the server. -1 disables the watchdog.

children.label: Max Chained Neighbour Updates
children.description: The maximum number of chained neighbour updates.

children.label: Region File Compression Algorithm
children.description: The compression level for region files.

children.label: Enable Synchronous Chunk Writes
children.description: Whether to enable synchronous chunk writes.

children.label: Operators
children.description: A list of UUIDs and/or names of players who have the operator role on the server.

children.label: Enable Whitelist
children.description: The whitelist ensures that only players who are on the list are allowed to enter the server.

children.label: Whitelist
children.description: A list of UUIDs and/or names of players who are whitelisted on the server.

categories.label: Content
categories.description: If you want to use a modpack from Modrinth, CurseForge or Feed The Beast, select the appropriate option in the "General" category under "Server Type".

children.label: CurseForge Files
children.description: A list of CurseForge files to be installed on the server.

children.label: CurseForge API Key
children.description: An API key required to access the CurseForge API. The API key can be generated in the CurseForge developer console.

children.label: Modrinth Projects
children.description: A list of Modrinth projects to be installed on the server.

children.label: Allowed Modrinth Version Types for Determining New Versions

options.label: Alpha versions, beta versions, and stable versions

children.label: PackWiz URL
children.description: The URL of a modpack definition file in PackWiz file format to install a modpack on the server.

children.label: SpigotMC.org Resources
children.description: A list of resources on SpigotMC.org to be installed on the server. Resource IDs or SpigotMC.org URLs can be specified.

children.label: Mod URLs
children.description: A list of URLs to the mod JAR files to be installed on the server.

children.label: Plugin URLs
children.description: A list of URLs to the plugin JAR files to be installed on the server.

children.label: World URL
children.description: Instead of using an existing world or generating a new world, you can also specify the URL of a compressed TAR file that contains a world.

children.label: Data Pack URLs
children.description: A list of URLs to the data pack ZIP files to be installed on the main world.

children.label: VanillaTweaks Share Code
children.description: A list of VanillaTweaks share codes to be installed on the server. The share code is the part of the URL that follows the # symbol.

children.label: VanillaTweaks File
children.description: A list of paths in the container to VanillaTweaks pack files in JSON format to be installed on the server.

children.label: Resource Pack URL
children.description: The URL to a ZIP archive containing the resource pack.

children.label: Resource Pack ID
children.description: An optional UUID to identify the resource pack.

children.label: Resource Pack SHA1
children.description: An optional SHA-1 digest of the resource pack, in lowercase and hexadecimal. It is recommended to provide this information as it is used to check the integrity of the resource pack.

children.label: Require Resource Pack
children.description: When enabled, players must download the resource pack to play on the server.

children.label: Resource Pack Prompt
children.placeholder: We use a custom resource pack. Please download it to play.
children.description: A custom message displayed to the player when prompted to download the resource pack. Can be left blank for a default message. Expects chat component syntax, may contain multiple lines.

children.label: Network Compression Threshold
children.description: The size of a packet in bytes before it is compressed. -1 disables compression.

children.label: Prevent Proxy Connections
children.description: Prevents players from connecting with an ISP/ASN other than the one they had when authenticating with Mojang.

children.label: Rate Limit
children.description: Maximum packets per second a player can send before getting kicked. Set to 0 to disable.

children.label: Use Native Transport
children.description: Enables optimized packet sending/receiving on Linux.

children.label: Enable Status Protocol
children.description: Enables the status protocol that is used to show server information in the server list.

children.label: Hide Player List in Status Responses
children.description: Hides the player list in the server list.

children.label: Enforce Secure Profile
children.description: Enforces that players can only join with a Mojang-signed public key. If this is disabled, all chat messages will be left unsigned and unable to be reported. Players will get warned about this when connecting to the server.

children.label: Status Heartbeat Interval
children.description: The interval in milliseconds for status heartbeat updates.

children.label: Commands to execute after server startup
Commands to execute after a player joins
Commands to execute after a player leaves
Commands to execute after the first player joins
children.description: These commands are only executed if no players were online on the server before.

children.label: Commands to execute after the last player leaves
children.description: These commands are only executed if no players are online on the server afterwards.

children.label: Pause when empty
children.description: The time in seconds before the server is paused when no players are online.

children.label: Player Idle Timeout
children.description: The time in minutes before a player is kicked from the server for being idle.

children.label: Enable Chat Message Previews
children.description: A server-controlled preview appears above the chat edit box, showing how the message will look when sent.

children.label: Broadcast Output of Console Commands to Operators
Broadcast Output of RCON Commands to Operators
Bug Report Link
children.description: The URL that is opened when a player clicks the “Report a Bug” button in the pause menu.

children.label: Accept Transfers
children.description: Allows the server to transfer clients to another server.

children.label: Announce Player Achievements
children.description: Broadcasts player advancements/achievements in chat.

children.label: Server Name
children.description: An optional server name used by newer server features.

children.label: Enable Snooper
children.description: Enables sending snooper telemetry data. Mostly relevant for older versions.

children.label: Permission Level of Functions in Command Blocks

categories.label: Advanced
categories.description: Advanced settings for the Minecraft server.

children.label: User ID
children.description: The Linux user ID that the server process will run as.

children.label: Group ID
children.description: The Linux group ID that the server process will run as.

children.label: Extra Arguments
children.description: Arguments that are passed to the JAR file (after the -jar option).

children.label: Enable JMX
children.description: Enables JMX (Java Management Extensions) for monitoring and managing the server.

children.label: JMX Host
children.description: The IP address or hostname to bind the JMX service to. Add a port forwarding of port 7091 to access JMX from outside the container.

children.label: Enable Rolling Logs
children.description: By default, the log file will grow indefinitely. Reconfigures the logger to use a rolling log files strategy.

children.label: Log Timestamps
children.description: Prepends timestamps to each log line before the Minecraft server is started.

children.label: Log Player IP Addresses
children.description: Displays the IP addresses of players in the server console and log file.

children.label: Enable Management Server
children.description: Enables the built-in management server.

children.label: Management Server Host
children.description: The host interface to bind the management server to.

children.label: Management Server Port
children.description: The port used by the management server.

children.label: Management Server Allowed Origins
children.description: Comma-separated allowed origins for management server requests.

children.label: Management Server Secret
children.description: Shared secret required to access the management server.

children.label: Enable Management Server TLS
children.description: Enables TLS for the management server endpoint.

children.label: Management Server TLS Keystore
children.description: Path to the keystore file used for management server TLS.

children.label: Management Server TLS Keystore Password
children.description: Password for the management server TLS keystore.
